widgets_values:
Cinematic Wuxia comedy scene, photorealistic, 8k resolution, dramatic lighting. Nighttime beach battlefield after a fight, a bright full moon in the cloudy sky. Burning torches in the distance, fallen soldiers scattered on the wet sand. In the foreground, a group of ancient Chinese martial artists in flowing Hanfu robes stand in a heroic but slightly exaggerated pose. 

Focus on the central male character (Xiao Bao): He wears a grey-blue long robe, long black hair blowing in the wind. He has a confident, slightly rogue, and humorous expression, looking directly at the camera. His mouth is wide open, actively speaking and shouting with exaggerated facial expressions, showing his teeth. He is gesturing with one hand, patting his chest or waving confidently. His posture is relaxed but showy. 

The female characters around him are looking at him with mixed expressions of amusement, eye-rolling, or slight worry, breaking the serious tension. 

Camera motion: Slow, dramatic push-in towards the central male character, starting from a wide shot of the group and ending in a medium close-up of him speaking. Low angle shot to emphasize his "heroic" but funny stature. 

Atmosphere: Strong wind blowing their robes and hair dynamically, flickering torchlight casting dramatic shadows, misty sea breeze. The overall mood is a mix of epic wuxia aesthetic and comedic, lighthearted storytelling. High detail, masterpiece.
